UPDATE jobs
        SET status = CASE
            WHEN attempts >= max_attempts THEN 'failed'
            ELSE 'pending'
        END,
        error_message = CASE
            WHEN attempts >= max_attempts THEN 'Heartbeat timeout after ' || attempts || ' attempts'
            ELSE NULL
        END,
        agent_id = NULL,
        claimed_at = NULL,
        last_heartbeat = NULL
        WHERE status IN ('claimed', 'running')
          AND last_heartbeat < now() - make_interval(secs => $1)
